name: environment-deploy-controls
goal: Compact revision and bench controls, select deployment environments with update times, and require explicit plugin deployment for preprod and prod

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Specification defines icon selectors, environment timestamps, scoped changes capped at stage, and explicit Cloudflare deploy plans. Existing workspace regression red: Commit remains visible. Policy regression red: protected environments were returned unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Compact shared controls, environment target/status, host-side bounded change promotion and single-use Cloudflare deployment plans are implemented. Unconfigured projects keep explicitly local changes.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 30 focused tests plus packaged dependency guard, 26 responsive browser cases, 135 remote tests and the built native flow passed. Selector red/green and bundled-import mutation proof retained under /tmp/harness-env-evidence and the in-progress report.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Full bun run check passed: root checks, kernel, CLI integration/package tests, reports, planning, desktop (851 unit tests, 176 browser cases), collaboration, hub, remote and relay. Packaged-Node mutation guard and native E2E are green. Advisory Jev remains incomplete; no live app deployment was run.
